title: TAA Lemma 1: Arithmetic Unitarity. The Riemann Hypothesis as Absence of Ghosts and Runaway Modes for the Scaling Flow of the Weil Form
summary: On C_c^infty(R) (functions of the logarithmic scale u = log x), the Weil explicit-formula pairing Q is a Hermitian form, defined arithmetically by primes, the pole and the archimedean place, and spectrally by the zeros. The scaling flow T_t F(u) = F(u - t) is always Q-isometric (pseudo-unitary). We show: (a) the exponential growth rate of the matrix coefficients t -> Q(T_t F, G) is exactly Theta - 1/2, where Theta = sup Re rho; (b) RH Q >= 0 the flow is realized by a strongly continuous unitary group on a Hilbert space all matrix coefficients are bounded; (c) the number of negative squares…

review.reason: Analyzes the scaling flow of the Weil explicit-formula form and its growth rates.
